name: Shakshuka
instructions: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil over medium heat until soft and beginning to colour.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli and cook for one minute until fragrant.
Pour in the tomatoes, season, and simmer for 10 minutes until thick enough to hold a trench.
Make four wells and crack an egg into each one.
Cover and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still runny.
Scatter with parsley and serve straight from the pan with flatbread.
